import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

src = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')

# ---- modify styles.xml ----
styles = ET.fromstring(src.read('xl/styles.xml'))
numfmts = styles.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numfmts.set('count', '1')
ET.SubElement(numfmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt', {'numFmtId': '164', 'formatCode': '0.0%'})
cellxfs = styles.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
cellxfs.set('count', '5')
ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf', {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '0', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'})
ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf', {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '1', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'})
styles_xml = ET.tostring(styles, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---- modify sheet1.xml ----
sheet = ET.fromstring(src.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
dim = sheet.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')
cols = sheet.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col', {'width': '12', 'customWidth': '1', 'min': '8', 'max': '8'})
sheetdata = sheet.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
rows = sheetdata.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row')

def make_text_cell(ref, style, text):
    c = ET.Element(f'{{{NS}}}c', {'r': ref, 's': style, 't': 'inlineStr'})
    is_ = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
    t = ET.SubElement(is_, f'{{{NS}}}t')
    t.text = text
    return c

def make_formula_cell(ref, style, formula):
    c = ET.Element(f'{{{NS}}}c', {'r': ref, 's': style})
    f = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
    f.text = formula
    ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v')
    return c

# header row 1
header = rows[0]
header.append(make_text_cell('H1', '1', 'Profit Margin %'))

# data rows 2..9
for row in rows[1:9]:
    n = row.get('r')
    row.append(make_formula_cell(f'H{n}', '3', f'G{n}/E{n}'))

# total row 10
total = rows[9]
total.append(make_formula_cell('H10', '4', 'G10/E10'))

sheet_xml = ET.tostring(sheet, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---- rebuild the workbook ----
out = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in src.infolist():
    data = src.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = sheet_xml
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = styles_xml
    out.writestr(item, data)
out.close()
src.close()
print("done")
